electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Clear Slim Phone Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A thin transparent case moulded from flexible polyurethane with raised edges around the screen and camera. It adds light protection while keeping the phone's original colour visible.

reviews.body: Fits snugly and the cutouts line up well with the buttons. Arrived in a neat paper box.
Barely adds any bulk to the phone. The clear back has stayed fairly clean after a month.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Rugged Armor Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A two-layer case with a hard polycarbonate shell over a soft rubber inner frame. The corners are thickened to absorb knocks from everyday drops.

reviews.body: Feels very solid in the hand and the grip is good. It survived a fall on the kitchen floor without a mark.
Protects well but it is quite chunky and a little tight in my jeans pocket.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Leather Flip Wallet Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A folding case with a faux leather cover and two inner slots for cards or folded notes. A magnetic clasp keeps the flap closed and the cover doubles as a simple stand.

reviews.body: The stitching looks neat and the card slots hold my metro card and ID without sagging.
Magnet is firm enough to keep it shut in my bag. Smell of the material faded after a couple of days.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Matte Silicone Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A soft silicone case with a matte finish and a microfibre lining to reduce scratches on the back of the phone. It is available in several solid colours.

reviews.body: Smooth, soft feel and it does not slip off the table. The colour matches the photo.
Good for daily use, though it picks up a bit of lint from my pockets.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Shockproof Bumper Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A bumper-style frame in flexible TPU with air-cushion corners and an open back. The raised lip sits above the screen and camera glass when the phone is placed face down.

reviews.body: Easy to put on and take off. The raised lip keeps the camera off the desk.
Corner cushions feel reassuring and the phone still looks slim. Delivery came a day early.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Magnetic Ring Stand Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A hard case with a built-in metal ring on the back that folds out to hold the phone upright or serves as a finger grip. It is made from polycarbonate with a soft-touch coating.

reviews.body: The ring is sturdy and I use it every day to watch videos on the table. Hinge still feels tight.
Handy for one-handed typing. The coating feels pleasant but shows fingerprints on the dark colour.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Floral Print Hard Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A slim hard case with a glossy printed floral pattern under a protective lacquer layer. The inside has a thin cushioned lining to keep the phone from rattling.

reviews.body: The print is sharp and the colours look rich in daylight. Packaging was tidy with a small cloth.
Pretty design but the gloss scuffs a little where it touches my keys.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Waterproof Pouch Case
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A sealed transparent pouch with a roll-down lock and an adjustable neck cord, made from thick PVC. It suits rainy commutes, beach days and shallow splashes.

reviews.body: Kept my phone dry during a heavy rain walk. The touchscreen works through the plastic, though a bit stiffly.
Cord length is comfortable and the lock clicks firmly. Fits a large phone with room to spare.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: 20W Wall Charger
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A compact wall adapter with one USB-C port rated at 20 watts. It has a flame-retardant casing and folding-free pins for a standard Indian socket.

reviews.body: Small enough to leave plugged in the extension board without blocking other sockets. It stays only mildly warm.
Charges my phone to half in a reasonable time. The plastic feels a bit light but solid enough.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Dual Port Wall Charger
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A wall charger with one USB-C and one USB-A port that share a total output of 30 watts. It lets two small devices charge from a single socket.

reviews.body: Handy at night when I charge my phone and a smartwatch together. Both ports work fine.
Good build, the pins sit firmly in the board. Box included a short instruction leaflet.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: 65W Laptop Charger
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A higher-power adapter with two USB-C ports and a total rating of 65 watts, suited to thin laptops, tablets and phones. The casing is made from heat-resistant plastic with ventilation slots.

reviews.body: Runs my ultrabook without any warning on screen, and I can carry just one brick for everything.
Works well but it is bigger than I expected and blocks the neighbouring socket.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Car Charger Adapter
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A small adapter that fits a vehicle's 12 volt socket and offers two USB ports with a combined 24 watts. A soft indicator light shows when it is powered.

reviews.body: Fits tightly in my car socket without wobbling. Phone charges while navigation is running.
Metal body feels well made and the light is not too bright at night.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Wireless Charging Pad
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A round pad that charges compatible phones without a cable at up to 10 watts. It has a non-slip top surface and comes with a USB-C input cable.

reviews.body: Just drop the phone on top and it starts. Rubber surface keeps the phone in place on my bedside table.
Works, but charging pauses if my case is too thick. Fine with a thin cover.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: 10000mAh Power Bank
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A portable battery pack with a 10000mAh lithium-polymer cell, one USB-C and one USB-A output. Four small lights show the remaining charge level.

reviews.body: Charged my phone about two times on a day trip. It is slim enough to slide into a jeans pocket.
Solid weight and neat finish. Takes a few hours to refill but that is normal for this size.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Foldable Travel Charger
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A wall adapter with three USB ports and a cord-free body that includes fold-in pins, so it fits flat in a bag. Total output is shared at up to 18 watts.

reviews.body: Great for travel, the pins fold in properly and do not scratch other items in my pouch.
Three ports covered my phone, earbuds and a camera at the hotel. Plastic is matte and feels decent.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Desktop Charging Station
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A flat four-port charging hub with a 40 watt total output, built to sit on a desk or shelf. It has a long attached cord with an Indian two-pin plug.

reviews.body: Keeps all our family phones in one spot on the shelf. The cord is long enough to reach the wall.
Ports are well spaced so thick plugs fit. Slightly warm after a long night but nothing worrying.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Braided USB-C Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A one metre USB-C to USB-C cable wrapped in nylon braiding with reinforced connector ends. It supports charging up to 60 watts and basic data transfer.

reviews.body: Braiding feels tough and it does not tangle in my bag. Connectors click in firmly.
Charges my tablet and phone with the same cable. Colour looks slightly darker than the listing photo.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Two Metre Charging Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A long USB-A to USB-C cable with a flexible PVC jacket, meant for charging while the phone is used from a bed or sofa. Length is two metres.

reviews.body: Reaches from the wall to my bed with some slack. Cable is soft and bends easily.
Does what it says, and it arrived coiled neatly with a small tie.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Short Pocket Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A twenty-five centimetre USB-C cable with a thin rubber coat, sized for power banks and car ports. It is light and easy to coil into a pocket.

reviews.body: Perfect with my power bank because there is no extra length to deal with.
Very small and light. Only used for charging so far and it works without any problem.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Right Angle Gaming Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A USB-C cable with an L-shaped connector that sits flat against the phone when held sideways. The jacket is a flat tangle-resistant rubber and the length is 1.5 metres.

reviews.body: The angled end keeps the cord out of my palm during long games. Quite sturdy near the bend.
Flat cable does not knot, which I appreciated. Fits cases with a deeper port opening too.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Micro USB Charging Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A one metre USB-A to micro USB cable for older phones, speakers and power banks. The moulded connectors have strain relief to reduce bending at the joint.

reviews.body: Still useful for my old speaker and a few gadgets. Plug is a snug fit.
Charging is slow compared with newer cables, which I expected, but it works fine as a spare.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Three In One Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A single cable with a USB-A plug and three interchangeable heads for USB-C, micro USB and a small proprietary phone connector. Total length is 1.2 metres.

reviews.body: Keeps one cable in my car for the whole family. Each head is labelled clearly.
Handy for guests with different phones. Only one head can be used at a time.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Coiled Car Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A spring-style coiled USB-C cable that stretches to about 1.2 metres and returns to a compact length. It is made with a durable TPE jacket suited to dashboards.

reviews.body: Stays tidy on my dashboard and does not hang down around the gear stick.
Coil is springy and the plugs feel tight. Good value for the price.

electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.name: Data Sync USB-C Cable
electronics-accessories-mobile-accessori.description: A shielded USB-C to USB-A cable rated for fast file transfer between a phone and a computer. It has gold-plated contacts and a 1.5 metre braided sleeve.

reviews.body: Copied a folder of photos to my laptop without any drops in connection.
Thicker than my other cables, which makes it feel sturdy. Connector sizing is accurate.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: Over-Ear Wired Headphones
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: A pair of closed-back headphones with 40mm drivers and a detachable 3.5mm cable. Padded earcups and a steel-reinforced headband make them suited to long listening at a desk.

reviews.body: Earcups are comfortable for hours and the bass is clean for the price. Cable is long enough for my desktop.
Sturdy build. The headband clamps slightly at first but loosens after a week.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: Foldable over-ear headphones with Bluetooth 5 and a built-in microphone for calls. They run on a rechargeable battery that gives around twenty hours of playback.

reviews.body: Pairs quickly and the volume buttons are easy to find. Sound is balanced with clear vocals.
Folds flat into the included pouch. Battery has lasted through my whole week of commuting.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: Noise Reducing Headphones
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: Wireless headphones with an electronic noise reduction mode that softens steady background sounds like fans and traffic. Soft protein-leather ear pads are fitted over memory foam.

reviews.body: Takes the edge off the train rumble. It does not remove all noise but makes travel calmer.
Comfortable, but the noise reduction makes a faint hiss in quiet rooms.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: Kids Volume Limited Headphones
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: Lightweight on-ear headphones with a volume limiter set at a modest level, and a stretchy adjustable headband. A shared audio port lets two sets be linked for listening together.

reviews.body: My daughter wears them for her online classes and the headband adjusts well for her small head.
Light and bright colours. The cable is a bit short but fine for a tablet.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: Gaming Headset With Mic
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: A wired over-ear headset with a bendable boom microphone and a single 3.5mm plug for consoles and PCs. The earcups are padded and the inline control mutes the mic.

reviews.body: Teammates say my voice comes through clearly. Footsteps in games are easy to hear.
Comfortable for a few hours of play. The mic arm stays where I bend it.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: On-Ear Foldable Headphones
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: Compact on-ear headphones with swivelling cups and a folding hinge, plus a 1.2 metre cable with a single-button microphone. They are meant for light travel use.

reviews.body: Pack down small in my backpack. Sound is bright and fine for podcasts.
Cable has a good thickness and the button answers calls reliably.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: Studio Monitor Headphones
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: Closed-back wired headphones with 50mm drivers tuned for a flat sound, a coiled cable and a screw-on quarter-inch adapter. They suit basic home recording and editing.

reviews.body: Helpful for editing my videos because nothing sounds exaggerated. Build feels dependable.
Coiled cable is handy at the desk. The pads feel firm at first and then settle.

electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.name: Sports Neckband Headphones
electronics-accessories-audio-headphones.description: Wireless headphones joined by a flexible neckband, with ear hooks and a sweat-resistant coating. Magnetic ear tips snap together to pause music when not in use.

reviews.body: Stay on during my morning jog and the band is light on the neck.
Fine for workouts but the call quality is average in windy outdoor spots.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Pocket Bluetooth Speaker
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A palm-sized wireless speaker with a 5 watt driver and a rechargeable battery rated for around six hours of playback. It has a short wrist strap and a USB-C charging port.

reviews.body: Surprisingly loud in a small room and easy to carry with the strap.
Pairs in seconds and the casing has a pleasant rubbery feel.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Waterproof Outdoor Speaker
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A rugged cylinder speaker with an IPX6 splash-proof rating, 10 watt output and a carabiner loop. It is designed for balconies, picnics and camping.

reviews.body: Took it on a rainy trek and it kept playing. The clip on the bag is sturdy.
Sound is full outdoors, a bit boxy indoors. Charging port cover closes tightly.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Soundbar For TV
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A 60 centimetre soundbar with 24 watts of output, connecting to a television by optical cable, AUX or Bluetooth. A small remote controls volume and input.

reviews.body: Dialogue in films is clearer than my TV speakers. Setup took just a few minutes.
Compact enough for my TV stand and the remote is simple to use.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Desktop Computer Speakers
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A pair of wired stereo speakers with a front volume knob and a USB power cable, using a 3.5mm input. The wooden-look cabinets help reduce vibration on a desk.

reviews.body: Good for music while I work. The knob has a nice smooth turn.
Sound is decent but the cable between the two speakers is shorter than I wanted.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Portable Party Speaker
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A larger floor speaker with a 40 watt output, a built-in handle and wheels, and a wired microphone input. It includes a rechargeable battery and a basic coloured light strip.

reviews.body: Filled our terrace during a family function with plenty of volume to spare.
Wheels roll smoothly. The mic input worked fine for a small speech.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Smart Alarm Clock Speaker
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A bedside speaker with a digital clock display, two alarm settings and Bluetooth playback. The soft fabric cover and dimmable display make it suitable for a bedroom.

reviews.body: Looks tidy by my bed and the display can be dimmed to a faint glow.
Alarm is gentle but loud enough to wake me. Bluetooth reconnects on its own each night.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Shower Suction Speaker
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A small splash-resistant speaker with a suction cup base that sticks to tiles or glass. It plays for about five hours per charge and connects over Bluetooth.

reviews.body: Sticks firmly to my bathroom tile and has held for weeks.
Clear sound for the size. The charging flap is easy to seal.

electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.name: Retro Wooden Speaker
electronics-accessories-audio-speakers.description: A tabletop Bluetooth speaker in a wooden cabinet with a metal grille and two rotary knobs for volume and bass. It also takes a wired 3.5mm input.

reviews.body: Looks lovely on the bookshelf and has a warm, round sound.
Knobs feel solid. It is on the heavy side but stays put on the shelf.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: True Wireless Earbuds
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: Compact in-ear earbuds with Bluetooth 5 and touch controls, supplied with a pocket charging case. The case adds about three further full charges to the earbuds.

reviews.body: Fit well with the medium tips and the touch controls respond quickly.
Case is small and snaps shut well. Sound has good clarity at normal volume.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: Wired In-Ear Earphones
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: Classic earphones with a 1.2 metre cable, a 3.5mm plug and an inline microphone with one button. Three sizes of silicone tips are included.

reviews.body: Simple and reliable. No battery to worry about and the cable does not tangle much.
Good value for the price. The mic is clear on calls.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: Neckband Earphones
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: Wireless in-ear earphones connected by a soft silicone neckband housing the battery. Magnets hold the buds together and a vibrating motor signals incoming calls.

reviews.body: Easy to wear all day and the battery lasts through my office hours.
Comfortable but the bass is lighter than I would like for music.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: Gaming Low Latency Earbuds
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: True wireless earbuds with a game mode that reduces audio delay and a small LED on the case. Each bud has a short stem for a firmer fit.

reviews.body: Audio matches the action on screen in the mobile game I play most.
Stems sit well in my ears. Game mode is easy to toggle with three taps.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: Clip-On Open Ear Earbuds
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: Open-style earbuds that hang over each ear with a small speaker pointing toward the ear canal. They leave the ear uncovered so surrounding sounds stay audible.

reviews.body: I can hear my surroundings while walking to work, which suits me.
Very light and sit stably. Sound is thinner than in-ear types but fine for talks.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: USB-C Wired Earphones
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: Earphones with a USB-C plug for phones that lack a headphone socket, built-in digital converter and an inline mic. The cable is 1.1 metres with a flat tangle-resistant design.

reviews.body: Plugged straight in and worked without any app. Sound is clean and detailed.
Cable is flat and tidy. The remote buttons are easy to press by feel.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: Mini Sleep Earbuds
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: Very small wireless earbuds with a low-profile soft silicone body designed to stay comfortable while lying on a side. They pair over Bluetooth and come with a slim round charging case.

reviews.body: They do not poke out of my ear when I lie down. Good for soft music or audiobooks at night.
Comfortable, though one bud dropped its connection twice during the first week.

electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.name: Earbuds With Case Display
electronics-accessories-audio-earbuds.description: True wireless earbuds with a charging case that shows remaining battery as a number on a small screen. The buds are in-ear with a rubber seal and carry a splash-resistant rating.

reviews.body: Seeing the exact battery percentage on the case is very convenient.
Fit is firm on my morning walk. The case lid hinge feels well built.
